obs_weather_coverage: Cloud forecasts are available for locations covered by the US National Weather Service. This location is outside that coverage.
obs_weather_loading: Checking the NWS cloud forecast for this location…
obs_weather_error: The cloud forecast could not be refreshed. Try again when connected. Saved values below may be out of date.
obs_weather_intro: Check the cloud forecast for your selected location. This optional request needs an internet connection.
obs_weather_deep_time: Present-day weather forecasts do not apply to deep-time skies.
obs_weather_pause: Pause time-lapse to match weather to the displayed sky.
obs_weather_stale: Saved forecast is stale. Refresh it before planning an observation.
obs_weather_no_time: No cloud forecast is available for the selected simulation time. Choose a time in the forecast window below.
obs_weather_current: Cloud forecast for the selected simulation time.
obs_weather_hours: Cloud cover over the next six hours
obs_weather_limit: Cloud cover is the forecast percentage of sky covered by clouds, not a chance of seeing an object. Local clouds, haze and turbulence can vary. The sky view remains an astronomy simulation.
obs_plan_deep_time: Return to Today in the star-motion controls to plan a night with current star and planet positions.
obs_plan_unavailable: Choose a valid place, date and time zone to plan a night.
obs_plan_dark_target: Above the horizon in a dark sky
obs_plan_daylight_target: Above the horizon only in daylight
obs_plan_below_target: Below the horizon throughout this night
obs_plan_span: Local noon to noon. Early-morning hours belong to the preceding night.
obs_plan_date_boundary: This night crosses the supported date range. Jump buttons use times within 1900–2099.
obs_plan_midnight_sun: The Sun stays above the horizon. There is no night observing window here on this date.
obs_plan_no_dark: The sky never becomes fully dark during this night. Bright objects may still be visible in twilight.
obs_plan_polar_night: The Sun stays below the horizon. The shading still separates twilight from full darkness.
obs_plan_change_site: Try a different observing location for this target.
obs_plan_change_date: Try another date for a night-time opportunity.
obs_plan_empty: Add objects to tonight’s list to compare their paths and choose a time.
obs_plan_explain: The curve shows altitude; 0° is the horizon. The dot marks the highest sampled position in full darkness, or in twilight when the target has no dark-sky window. For the Sun, it marks the daytime peak. Times are approximate, sampled every 10 minutes. Clouds, moonlight and skyglow can still limit what you see.
obs_saved_unavailable: This target is not in the loaded catalog. Retry the star catalog or choose another object.
obs_pick_plan_hint: Select an object in the sky or finder. Add it to tonight’s list to compare observing times.
obs_tour_hint2: Use the ★ target button below the finder to locate it in the sky.
